exercises: minLength, maxLength, pattern, minimum, maximum, multipleOf, exclusiveMinimum, default, enum and format
note: In OpenAPI 3.0 exclusiveMinimum is a boolean that qualifies minimum, not a number. OAS 3.1 changes it to a number. Written here in the 3.0 form deliberately: a browser that expects the 3.1 form will read `true` as the bound and show a nonsense constraint rather than failing loudly.
doNotChangeFixture: Assertions marked pending describe correct behaviour the browser does not have yet. A failure on one of them is a backlog item, not a fixture defect. Do not edit this fixture or its expectations to match what the app currently does.

expected.assert: isbn shows its pattern, rendered as literal text and not interpreted as markup.
copies shows minimum 0, maximum 40 and default 1.
publishedOn shows type string with format date.
format shows its four enum values.

expected.why: The constraint list is a fixed set of keys: minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, pattern and default. multipleOf is not among them.

expected.assert: conditionScore shows that the minimum of 0 is exclusive, phrased as a bound rather than as the raw key exclusiveMinimum with the value true.
expected.why: exclusiveMinimum is not in the constraint list, so the qualifier is dropped and the bound reads as inclusive when it is not.
